product.title: Extendable Microfiber Cleaning Duster – 83.5 cm Soft Round Head
product.body_html:
Keep your home spotless effortlessly with our Extendable Microfiber Cleaning Duster. This versatile duster, featuring a soft, round head and an 83.5 cm stainless steel handle, is designed to reach difficult corners, fan blades, vents, and high shelves with ease. It efficiently traps dust to maintain a pristine environment, making your cleaning routine simpler and more effective.

Key features

  • Extendable stainless-steel handle reaches up to 83.5 cm for high and hard-to-reach areas
  • Extra-soft microfiber head effectively attracts and holds dust without scattering particles
  • Round design is perfect for cleaning around fan blades, pipes, and curved surfaces
  • Lightweight and flexible construction ensures comfortable daily use and easy manoeuvrability
  • Washable and reusable microfiber head promotes sustainable and economical cleaning
  • Ideal tool for dusting ceiling fans, high shelves, air vents, and tight corners

Materials & care

This cleaning duster combines a durable stainless-steel extendable handle with a high-performance microfiber head. To ensure its longevity and effectiveness, gently hand wash the microfiber head or use a washing machine on a delicate cycle. Allow the head to air dry completely before reattaching and reusing the duster for optimal cleaning results.

FAQ

Q1: How long does the handle extend?
A: The stainless-steel handle of this extendable microfiber cleaning duster extends up to 83.5 cm, providing ample reach for high areas.
Q2: Is the duster head washable?
A: Yes, the microfiber duster head is fully washable and reusable, making it an eco-friendly cleaning solution.
Q3: What makes this duster effective for cleaning?
A: Its soft microfiber material and round design efficiently trap dust from various surfaces, including curved and hard-to-reach spots.
Q4: Can this duster be used for daily cleaning?
A: Absolutely, its lightweight and flexible design makes it comfortable and convenient for everyday dusting tasks.
